comment: Google Alerts RSS dragnet configuration. Paste each alert's RSS feed URL from Google Alerts (https://www.google.com/alerts — set 'Deliver to: RSS feed', then copy the feed link, https://www.google.com/alerts/feeds/<user-id>/<alert-id>). The 'merged' entry may hold the single combined feed instead; the per-alert entries give better auto-tagging. Keep queries mirrored with the dragnet table in TRAWLERPROMPT.md.

feeds.query: "directed energy" OR "tactical power" OR "sensor-to-shooter" OR hypersonic OR ("advanced materials" AND military)
"military robotics" OR "unmanned systems" OR "cyber warfare" OR ("artificial intelligence" AND military)
("autonomous weapons" OR "unmanned surface vessel" OR "drone swarm" OR "military AI") AND ("testing" OR "deployment" OR "capability" OR "unveiled")
("directed energy weapon" OR "tactical laser" OR "high-power microwave" OR "electronic warfare") AND ("intercept" OR "successful test" OR "fielded" OR "demonstration")

("grey zone" OR "force sustenance" OR "military logistics" OR "island defense" OR "force projection" OR "military maneuver" OR "expeditionary") AND (technology OR tech OR system OR autonomous OR software)
